body_lead: Telangana government signs Rs 3,500 crore pact with ST Telemedia for AI-ready data centre in Hyderabad The campus is expected to have a capacity of up to 100 MW, making it one of India's largest data centre projects, the CMO stated. Singapore: The Telangana Government on Saturday signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STTDGC) India to establish a state-of-the-art data centre campus in Hyderabad's Meerkhanpet, the Chief Minister's Office said, taking to X.
